WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: A film saved to an authenticated user's personal watchlist with viewing progress and personal notes.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the watchlist owner.

status.description: Current viewing status for this film.

addedAt.description: Server timestamp when the film was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last status or note update.

UserRating.title: UserRating
UserRating.description: A verified user's star rating and optional review for a curated film.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reviewer.

authorName.description: Public display name shown alongside the review.

review.description: Optional short critique or viewer note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the rating was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the rating was last updated.

/users/{userId}/watchlist/{movieId}.description: Private personalized watchlist items owned by a specific user.

/ratings/{ratingId}.description: Community user ratings and reviews keyed deterministically by {userId}_{movieId}.
